---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(flexdashboard)
library(here)
library(rio)

nhanes <- import(here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"))

# Average systolic blood pressure (same definition as Assignment 3, Exercise 4)
nhanes <- nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(cbind(systolic_bp_1, systolic_bp_2,
                             systolic_bp_3, systolic_bp_4), na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_sbp = ifelse(is.nan(avg_sbp), NA, avg_sbp)
  )

pct_21_plus <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
pct_sbp_120 <- round(100 * mean(nhanes$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
```

Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### Age distribution of the NHANES sample

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(here("figures", "age_distribution.png"))
```

Row {data-height=350}
-------------------------------------

### Participants aged 21 or older (%)

```{r}
gauge(pct_21_plus, min = 0, max = 100, symbol = "%",
      gaugeSectors(success = c(70, 100), warning = c(40, 69), danger = c(0, 39)))
```

### Average systolic BP above 120 mm Hg (% of participants with a reading)

```{r}
valueBox(paste0(pct_sbp_120, "%"), icon = "fa-heartbeat", color = "warning")
```
